excluded: Y Combinator and Y Combinator Community accounts
third-party posts that quote or thank a partner
generic S26 or YC content without one specific local S26 company attribution

searches.query: Exact URL and platform-post-ID membership scan across the required ledger, validated, rejected, queue, progress, and prior S26 top-voice artifacts
searches.outcome: Established a 499-URL and 347-post-ID baseline; all four rows retained below are net-new to the baseline.

searches.query: Fresh TwStalker recent-profile card sweep for every source-listed yc_partners X handle, with two supplemental name-matched profiles isolated from author-proof decisions
searches.outcome: Only already-ledgered Tyler Bosmeny company matches surfaced. No new X candidate was retained.

searches.query: FxTwitter post-level API validation of every fresh mirror status ID absent from search-ledger.json
searches.outcome: No unledgered person-authored X status named a local S26 company, founder, handle, or domain.

searches.query: Native public profile and activity review for Garry Tan, Harj Taggar, Jared Friedman, Gustaf Alströmer, Tom Blomfield, Brad Flora, Pete Koomen, Ankit Gupta, Tyler Bosmeny, and David Lieb
searches.outcome: Current authored posts, shares, repost labels, and likes were separated. The company-attributed person-authored rows visible for Ankit, Tyler, and Jared were already ledgered; founder/company reposts and likes were excluded.

Sixteen new exact-author queries produced no qualifying person-authored company-specific S26 row. Results were founder announcements, YC-org posts, third-party quotations, unrelated Summer 2026 content, one generic Jared post, or empty.

searches.query: Open and validate each net-new post-level candidate against native heading, author identity, visible metrics, local S26 roster, and top-voice roster
searches.outcome: Four net-new URLs were rejected: two founder-authored announcements, one generic partner-authored post without company attribution, and one YC-org post attributed to partners.

searches.query: Prior exact-name sweep across all 83 S26 companies, top-voice handles, and S26 variants
searches.outcome: The completed HN Algolia query family in s26-topvoices-tenth-pass.json was reviewed; it had no net-new qualifying comment and was not duplicated.

searches.query: Prior partner-name plus S26 company/founder searches on YouTube, Reddit, and Product Hunt
searches.outcome: Completed cross-platform query families in the seventh, eighth, ninth, and tenth passes were reviewed and not rerun; none supplied an unledgered qualifying people-only row.

limitations: This is exhaustive over the publicly reachable surfaces, local 83-company roster, source-listed partner roster, and prior dedupe ledger available at check time; private or login-only activity is not observable.

X mirror pagination became rate-limited after the fresh recent-profile sweep. Every newly observed status ID was still validated post-by-post, and prior deeper profile sweeps were reviewed instead of repeated.
LinkedIn sometimes exposes only relative timestamps. Exact postedAt values here are decoded from the native activity IDs, while the visible relative labels are preserved separately.
Native metrics are capture-time snapshots and can change after checkedAt.
result: No net-new qualifying people-authored YC partner source was found for a local S26 company. Nothing was imported and no canonical evidence, graph, test, or code file was edited.
